notes: ⚖️ Smart calorie budget: your daily target now works like a weekly budget. Ate 400 under yesterday? Today’s limit becomes 2,900.
Go over and the app checks your 7-day average before calling it a problem, and shows what tomorrow’s budget will be.
Any one day moves by at most 25%, so a big night out is paid back gently over a couple of days. Protein still resets every day.
Tap the Calories ring to see the math, your last 7 days, and “Planning a big meal later?” to check a dinner out before you go.
⚖️ Weigh-in up the morning after a big day? The app now explains it’s mostly water and salt, not fat.
